name: TP5100
description: TP5100 降圧スイッチング式 リチウムイオン充電IC (QFN-16 4x4)。1セル 4.2V / 2セル 8.4V を CS 端子で切替 (開放=4.2V、VREG につなぐ=8.4V、GND=停止)。入力 4.5〜12V。充電電流 = 0.1 ÷ Rs[Ω] [A] (Rs は VS-BAT 間、0.1Ωで1A、最大2A)。プリチャージ(1セル2.9V/2セル5.8V未満) → 定電流 → 定電圧、満充電後に 80%まで下がると再充電。RTRICK 端子の抵抗でプリチャージ電流を設定 (50kで20%、開放で100%)。TS は電池の温度検出 (GND につなぐと無効)。VIN はピン1,4,5,16、LX はピン2,3 をまとめて「VIN」「LX」として扱います (パッドは同じ接続)。スイッチングは平均化した動作モデルで、リップル・損失・熱制限・入力電流の降圧効果は扱いません (入力電流は出力電流と同じ)。数値は概算

sim.name: TP5100
sim.text:
.subckt TP5100 vin lx pwr gnd vs bat vreg ts rtrick cs stdby chrg
* TP5100 behavioural model (averaged buck charger): the switching is replaced by a voltage source on LX
* whose level is the duty ratio times VIN. Control signals are in "sense volts": 0.1 V across Rs = full current.
Vone one gnd DC 1
V36 v36 gnd DC 3.6
V4 v4 gnd DC 4
V1c v1c gnd DC 1
V01 v01 gnd DC 0.1
V225 v225 gnd DC 2.25
V40 v40 gnd DC 4.0
V5 v5 gnd DC 5
V42 v42 gnd DC 4.2
V84 v84 gnd DC 8.4
V29 v29 gnd DC 2.9
V58 v58 gnd DC 5.8
Vr1 r1 gnd DC 0.1
Vbo bo bat DC 0.1
* internal 5 V supply (VREG) once VIN is above the under-voltage lockout
Svr v5 vreg vin v36 SWC
Rvr vreg gnd 1Meg
* CS: left open = single cell (4.2 V), high = two cells (8.4 V), low = shut down
Rcs1 vreg cs 1Meg
Rcs2 cs gnd 1Meg
Sa1 v42 vfl v4 cs SWC
Sb1 v84 vfl cs v4 SWC
Rvfl vfl gnd 100k
Sa2 v29 vtk v4 cs SWC
Sb2 v58 vtk cs v4 SWC
Rvtk vtk gnd 100k
* trickle current as a fraction of the full current: 0.1 + 0.9 x V(RTRICK); 50k gives 20 %, open gives 100 %
Rtr1 one rtrick 400k
Rtr2 rtrick gnd 1G
Vf0 f1 gnd DC 0.1
Ef f2 f1 rtrick gnd 0.9
Er0 r0 gnd f2 gnd 0.1
* current reference: full below the trickle threshold -> reduced
Sr1 r1 rf bat vtk SWC
Sr0 r0 rf vtk bat SWC
Rrf rf gnd 100k
* what the sense resistor shows now, and the voltage loop (the current is reduced within 50 mV of the float voltage)
Es s gnd vs bat 1
Eb cb gnd vfl bat 2
Sma rf m cb rf SWC
Smb cb m rf cb SWC
Rm m gnd 100k
* the charger runs when VIN is above the cell by 0.1 V and above 3.6 V, CS is not low and the cell temperature is fine
* (TS tied to GND or left open = no temperature check; otherwise 45 % to 80 % of VREG)
Sg1 one n1 vin bo SWC
Sg2 n1 n2 vin v36 SWC
Sg3 n2 n3 cs v1c SWC
Sts1 n3 on v01 ts SWC
Sts2 n3 t1 ts v225 SWC
Sts3 t1 on v40 ts SWC
Ron on gnd 1k
Rn1 n1 gnd 100Meg
Rn2 n2 gnd 100Meg
Rn3 n3 gnd 100Meg
Rt1 t1 gnd 100Meg
Rtsl ts gnd 10Meg
Su m u on gnd SWG
Ru u gnd 100k
* LX level: the cell voltage plus a push proportional to (reference - sense), limited to 0 .. VIN
Ecm cm gnd u s 100
Gint gnd cint u s 0.02
Cint cint gnd 1u
Rint cint gnd 10k
Ed0 d0 cm bat gnd 1
Ed d d0 cint gnd 1
Sc1 d c1 vin d SWC
Sc2 vin c1 d vin SWC
Rc1 c1 gnd 100k
Sc3 c1 c2 c1 gnd SWC
Sc4 gnd c2 gnd c1 SWC
Rc2 c2 gnd 100k
Elx ls gnd c2 gnd 1
Rsn ls ls2 0.001
Sd ls2 lx ls2 lx SWD
* the input current is taken equal to the output current (a real buck draws less)
Gin vin gnd ls ls2 1000
Riq vin gnd 75k
Rlx lx gnd 100Meg
* status (open drain): CHRG low while charging, STDBY low when the cell is full
Sch1 chrg k1 vs bat SWT
Sch2 chrg k1 vfl bat SWV
Sch3 k1 gnd on gnd SWG
Ssb1 stdby q1 bat vs SWN
Ssb2 q1 q2 bat vfl SWM
Ssb3 q2 gnd on gnd SWG
Rk1 k1 gnd 100Meg
Rq1 q1 gnd 100Meg
Rq2 q2 gnd 100Meg
Rch chrg gnd 100Meg
Rsb stdby gnd 100Meg
* PWR_ON- is low while VIN is present, otherwise it follows the cell
Spo pwr gnd vin v36 SWO
Sph pwr bat v36 vin SWO
Rpw pwr gnd 100Meg
.model SWC SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.001)
.model SWG SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0.5 VW=0.1)
.model SWD SW(RON=0.17 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.002)
.model SWO SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.005)
.model SWT SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0.01 VW=0.002)
.model SWV SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0.15 VW=0.01)
.model SWN SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=-0.01 VW=0.002)
.model SWM SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=-0.15 VW=0.01)
.ends TP5100
